new_result.summary: For a full-column original-coordinate carrier M0=A0P and arbitrary signed spectral packet E=U Theta U^T, the exact decomposition (A0+E)P=M0(I+R Theta V^T)+Uperp Theta V^T has orthogonal range pieces. Hence carrier contraction is controlled by L=I+R Theta V^T. If K=Theta^{-1}+V^TR is invertible, Woodbury bounds s_min(L); when eta=s_min(V^TR)>0 and min|theta|>=2/eta, all high signed eigenvalue magnitudes disappear from the lower bound. Arbitrarily many small signed eigenvalues cost one operator threshold, while carrier-invisible complementary spectrum is free.
key_equations: ((A0+E)^2)[H,H] = L^T(M0^TM0)L + V Theta Uperp^T Uperp Theta V^T
s_j(AP)>=[alpha s_j(M0)-h-delta]_+ after arbitrary ||E_low||<=h, SP=0, and ||TP||<=delta
